title: Gokumon Nadeshiko Koko ni Ari
titleNative: 獄門撫子此処ニ在リ
synopsis: The Gokumon clan - a bloodline from hell. Living in their mysterious stronghold in the ancient capital of Kyoto, they command fear not only from those who wield magic, but also monsters and demons. Nadeshiko Gokumon is the monster-devouring heiress of this wicked family. She is the most beautiful, and the most abominable, girl who comes straight from the flames of hell. However...... "Nadeshiko, I see you are as lovely as your name." The encounter with the most strange, disturbing, and beautiful woman, Amana Ichijiku, who laughs in her face without fear, changes Nadeshiko. Something lurks in the flower ceiling. A human sacrifice packed in a box. A curse that threaten the school. A deceitful beast. A shapeless monster. As the two confront one supernatural challenge after another, they eventually come face to face with the very thing they have been turning away from. "If it weren't for you, I would still be an ogre." A woman with a human soul in an ogre's body and a girl with a monstrous soul in a human body. The connection between the two is a story that will be sealed with blood. (Source: Gagaga Bunko, translated)

In his second chance at life, Kazuki tries to keep a low profile, avoid making friends, and live a peaceful life. But for some reason, Meiko Hikata — Amada’s childhood friend and a cool beauty known as the “Ice Empress”—begins to take an interest in him. (Source: Natalie, translated)

titleNative: 猫でごめん！
synonyms: Excuse Me for Being a Cat!
synopsis: Shiraishi Yayoi was a relatively unremarkable school girl, although a little clumsy, before a experimental accident changed her life forever. She was forced against her will by her father, self-proclaimed genius physicist, Shiraishi Sensei into a teleporter with a cat , and like in the movie "The Fly", she combined with the cat. Now, whenever she gets excited about anything, a pair of cat ears and a tail pop into existence. In the "catgirl" form, she has super powers, but the major drawback is that she also behaves like a cat when presented with the proper stimuli, like the sight of mice. She also has a boyfriend, but her "problem" tends to interfere in their dates since her excitement inevitably leads to her transformation into a catgirl. (Source: Taruby)

synopsis: Riding in a camper, eating delicious food, and enjoying the spectacular view. Saori Furuki was a university student in the engineering department and loved making things. After a car accident, she is reborn as Eline, the daughter of a viscount, However, her family treats her coldly, saying that she is incompetent and can only use magic to produce items, and she is exiled from the country. However, Eline's “alchemy magic” is a magic that has unlimited possibilities when combined with the knowledge from her previous life! Determined to live freely from now on, Eline has created a camper for starters. She can move around, live, and make things as she pleases. Together with Aristy, a martial maid who adores Eline, she begins her adventurous journey with a sense of ease. Eating delicious food, admiring the spectacular scenery, and creating useful things. This is a travel story about riding in a camper and enjoying another world with elegance. (Source: SB Creative, translated)
